A true bucket-list meal!|Recipe Book|TotK}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Gourmet Meat Stews are [[Meal]]s made by [[Cooking]] either [[Raw Gourmet Meat]] or a [[Raw Whole Bird]], [[Tabantha Wheat]], [[Fresh Milk]], and [[Goat Butter]] together in a [[Cooking Pot]]. When eaten, they heal several of [[Link]]'s [[Heart]]s to his [[Life Gauge]]. The [[Meat]]s in these Stews have simmered for so long that it melts in one's mouth, and they are considered a bucket-list Meal. By adding a fifth [[Ingredient]], several different variations of Gourmet Meat Stew can be made: * '''Chilly Gourmet Meat Stew''':{{Cite|{{Big|Chilly Gourmet Meat Stew}}
Grants low-level heat resistance.
The meat has simmered for so long it melts in your mouth. A true bucket-list meal!|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding cold Ingredients. Eating these will increase Link's [[Heat Resistance]] by one level. * '''Electro Gourmet Meat Stew''':{{Cite|{{Big|Electro Gourmet Meat Stew}}
Grants low-level electricity resistance.
The meat has simmered for so long it melts in your mouth. A true bucket-list meal!|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding electric Ingredients. Eating them will grant Link one level of [[Shock Resistance]]. * '''Enduring Gourmet Meat Stew''':{{Cite|{{Big|Enduring Gourmet Meat Stew}}
Restores and overfills your Stamina Wheel.
The meat has simmered for so long it melts in your mouth. A true bucket-list meal!|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding enduring Ingredients. These meals completely refill and overfill Link's [[Stamina Wheel]] when consumed. * '''Energizing Gourmet Meat Stew''':{{Cite|{{Big|Energizing Gourmet Meat Stew}}
Instantly refills some of your Stamina Wheel.
The meat has simmered for so long it melts in your mouth. A true bucket-list meal!|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding energizing Ingredients. If eaten, a portion of Link's Stamina Wheel will be replenished. * '''Hasty Gourmet Meat Stew''':{{Cite|{{Big|Hasty Gourmet Meat Stew}}
Grants a low-level movement-speed boost.
The meat has simmered for so long it melts in your mouth. A true bucket-list meal!|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding hasty Ingredients. When eaten, Link's movement speed will gain a temporary boost. * '''Hearty Gourmet Meat Stew''':{{Cite|{{Big|Hearty Gourmet Meat Stew}}
Restores your health and temporarily increases your maximum hearts.
The meat has simmered for so long it melts in your mouth. A true bucket-list meal!|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding hearty Ingredients. Eating these stews will heal all of Link's Hearts and temporarily increase his maximum Hearts. * '''Mighty Gourmet Meat Stew''':{{Cite|{{Big|Mighty Gourmet Meat Stew}}
Grants a low-level attack-power boost.
The meat has simmered for so long it melts in your mouth. A true bucket-list meal!|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding mighty Ingredients. If they are eaten, Link's attack power will be temporarily boosted. * '''Sneaky Gourmet Meat Stew''':{{Cite|{{Big|Sneaky Gourmet Meat Stew}}
Grants a low-level stealth boost.
The meat has simmered for so long it melts in your mouth. A true bucket-list meal!|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding sneaky Ingredients. When they are eaten, Link's [[Stealth]] will be temporarily boosted. * '''Spicy Gourmet Meat Stew''':{{Cite|{{Big|Spicy Gourmet Meat Stew}}
Grants low-level cold resistance.
The meat has simmered for so long it melts in your mouth. A true bucket-list meal!|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding spicy Ingredients. Link gains one temporary level of [[Cold Resistance]] when he eats these Stews. * '''Tough Gourmet Meat Stew''':{{Cite|{{Big|Tough Gourmet Meat Stew}}
Grants a low-level defense boost.
The meat has simmered for so long it melts in your mouth. A true bucket-list meal!|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding tough Ingredients. Link's [[Defense]] will increase if he eats this Stew. ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Stub|TotK}} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Food * Meal * Meat Stew * Prime Meat Stew }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Food, Health Restoring Items, Meals, Stews |items= BotW, TotK }}
